# Daily Report — 2026-08-12

## Task Completed
Added generic table CRUD tools for custom and standard ServiceNow tables.

New module: `src/servicenow_mcp/tools/generic_table_tools.py`

Five new tools:
- **list_records** — paginated query on any table; supports `sysparm_query` encoding, field selection, `order_by`, display values
- **get_record** — fetch a single record by `sys_id`; 404 guard; optional field projection
- **create_record** — POST arbitrary field dict to any table; returns created record with new `sys_id`
- **update_record** — PATCH by `sys_id`; empty-body guard; 404 guard; PATCH semantics (only supplied fields updated)
- **delete_record** — DELETE by `sys_id`; handles 200/204; 404 guard

All tools accept any table name including custom `u_` tables. Registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
